labels.reported: A source says it: needs at least one evidence item with a quote and a link.
labels.inferred: Reasoned from reported facts: needs a reasoning step and the ids it rests on.
labels.speculative: Plausible but weakly supported: drawn faint, never used for rankings or insights.

same_as.note: Links a private context node to a matching entity; computed on the device.

relates_to.note: Only for algorithmic link suggestions, always speculative.

shapes.rule: Every NewsItem has an outlet (source) and a date.
Every Claim has at least one quote and the id of what reported it.
Every reported link has at least one evidence item with a quote and a url.
Every inferred link has a reasoning step and at least one basis id.
Every affects link has an evidence quote or an inferred reasoning step.
